parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(
  jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object('id', category_id, 'name', category_name, 'items', items)
    ORDER BY category_sort_order, category_name
  ),
  '[]'::jsonb
) AS categories
FROM (
  SELECT category_id,
         category_name,
         category_sort_order,
         jsonb_agg(
           jsonb_build_object(
             'id',            item_id,
             'name',          item_name,
             'description',   item_description,
             'price_cents',   item_price_cents,
             'allergens',     COALESCE(to_jsonb(item_allergens), '[]'::jsonb),
             'is_vegetarian', item_is_vegetarian,
             'is_vegan',      item_is_vegan,
             'weight_g',      item_weight_g,
             'volume_ml',     item_volume_ml,
             'kcal',          item_kcal,
             'protein_g',     item_protein_g,
             'fat_g',         item_fat_g,
             'carbs_g',       item_carbs_g
           ) ORDER BY item_name
         ) AS items
  FROM get_current_menu($1::uuid, $2::char(2))
  GROUP BY category_id, category_name, category_sort_order
) c;
